editions.title: Nine lives. A world of its own.
editions.standfirst: Our first Solana Universe spotlight explores how GATTO’s black-and-gold identity became a place its community can visit and share.

sections.title: A familiar face. A new destination.
paragraphs: GATTO’s black-cat mascot and “Nine Lives. One Coin.” artwork give this showcase its starting point. The idea is simple: make a project recognizable the moment someone arrives.
Inside Parallax, that identity carries through to a dedicated About section, the project’s artwork and ticker, and a planet people can explore from Atlas.

sections.title: Black stone. Gold in orbit.
paragraphs: The planet pairs an obsidian surface with fine gold veins, double gold rings and a companion moon. Open the world to rotate it, pause its motion and see the design up close.
It is a visual home for the project’s story. Its size and position in Atlas do not represent market cap or a ranking.

sections.title: The next world could be yours.
paragraphs: This first feature shows the direction of Solana Universe: short stories about projects and the worlds they create, with a clear path from discovery to exploration.

Publish your own planet, add its Atlas listing, then share its link with the Parallax team through our community portal for editorial consideration. Standard publishing is free, and a token is not required.

editions.editorNote: This is a Parallax-created showcase. GATTO’s page includes its official website, X, published token address and public launch-wallet link. The feature does not verify project ownership or affiliation.
